name: altar
description: a stone altar draped in dusty black cloth. a shallow depression in the shape of a skull sits at its center, lined with faded runes. this is where the crystal skull belongs — the altar in the crypt, just as the journal said. when placed here, it might break the curse... or seal it forever.

params.success_message: you lift the dusty cloth. the skull-shaped depression is lined with symbols that pulse with a faint, dying light. the runes around the edge read: 'return what was taken. free what is bound. eleanor waits.'
